name: coronium-mobile-proxies
description: Check the health of the dedicated 4G/5G mobile proxies you rent from Coronium.io, rotate their IP, get connection details, compare plans and renewal quotes, and open support tickets. Sign in with your Coronium account in the browser - no token to copy. The plugin connects to the hosted Coronium server's directory profile, which has no money tools, so it never spends.
